card.name: Small words inside dose and interaction phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words or word parts right after dose or exposure wording, such as 'single oral doses of', 'effect on the', or 'AUC and Cmax of'. Seen in overdose and drug interaction passages.

modes.label: After single or oral doses
modes.description: The word 'of', 'doses' or 'does' following 'single oral dose' phrasing in overdose or interaction text.
modes.example: Patients and volunteers receiving single oral doses<< of>> 100 mg to 1

modes.label: Inside interaction or cycle terms
modes.description: A number or hyphenated piece in fold-increase, P-gp or 21-day cycle phrasing.
modes.example: resulted in more than <<2>>-fold increase in the AUC and C

modes.label: Linking word before pharmacokinetic term
modes.description: 'the' or 'of' leading into pharmacokinetics or a drug name after AUC and Cmax.
modes.example: did not elicit any apparent influence on<< the>> pharmacokinetics of norethind
